record.paper_title: On Plane Geometric Spanners: A Survey and Open Problems
record.original_question: For relaxed Gabriel graphs RGGβ(P) = BSKELβ(P) ∩ DT(P) with β in [0, 1], determine whether the known asymptotic upper and lower bounds on the spanning ratio are tight.

evidence.quote: Open Problem 12. Are these upper and lower bounds tight?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $P$ be a finite set of points in general position in the Euclidean plane. For a parameter $\beta\in[0,1]$, the $\beta$-skeleton $\mathrm{BSKEL}_\beta(P)$ is the graph on vertex set $P$ in which two points $p,q\in P$ are joined by an edge if and only if the open lune $L_\beta(p,q)$, defined as the intersection of the two open disks of radius $|pq|/\beta$ passing through both $p$ and $q$ and having centers on the line through $p$ and $q$ (with the convention that for $\beta=0$ the lune degenerates to the open segment $pq$, and for $\beta=1$ it is the open disk with diameter $pq$), contains no point of $P$. Let $\mathrm{DT}(P)$ denote the Delaunay triangulation of $P$. Define the relaxed Gabriel graph
$$\mathrm{RGG}_\beta(P) \;=\; \mathrm{BSKEL}_\beta(P)\,\cap\,\mathrm{DT}(P).$$
For a connected geometric graph $G$ on $P$, its spanning ratio (stretch factor) is
$$t(G) \;=\; \max_{p\neq q\in P}\frac{d_G(p,q)}{|pq|},$$
where $d_G$ denotes the shortest-path distance in $G$ with Euclidean edge weights. Let
$$f(n,\beta) \;=\; \sup\bigl\{t(\mathrm{RGG}_\beta(P)) : |P|=n,\ P\subset\mathbb{R}^2\text{ in general position}\bigr\}.$$
For each fixed $\beta\in[0,1]$, determine whether the currently known asymptotic upper and lower bounds on $f(n,\beta)$ as $n\to\infty$ are tight, i.e., whether they match up to constants (and if not, establish improved matching upper and lower bounds).
artifact.status_search_result: A literature search reveals work introducing relaxed Gabriel graphs and giving sublinear upper bounds on their spanning ratio, plus √n-type lower bounds for related β-skeletons. No source found that closes the gap between the known upper and lower bounds for RGG_β(P) for β∈[0,1]; tight asymptotic bounds remain unestablished.

status_evidence.title: Relaxed Gabriel Graphs (CCCG 2009)
status_evidence.snippet: Introduces RGG_β(P) interpolating between Delaunay and Gabriel; proves sublinear spanning ratio but does not establish matching lower bound.
status_evidence.claim: Upper bound is shown but matching lower bound not established.

status_evidence.title: On the Spanning Ratio of Gabriel Graphs and β-skeletons
status_evidence.snippet: For β-skeletons with β∈[1,2) there exist point sets with spanning ratio at least (1/2−o(1))√n; the corresponding tight bounds for relaxed variants intersected with DT are not given.
status_evidence.claim: Lower bounds exist for β-skeletons but tightness for relaxed Gabriel graphs is not resolved.
